text:
给别人送蛋糕的骑手，找老板多要了一盒蜡烛。

三联生活实验室今年4月发布的采访里，这位骑手快过自己的生日了。

“一会儿回去我就把蜡烛插在我的面条上。”

https://chinadigitaltimes.net/chinese/727105.html
subject_value: 配送蛋糕的骑手为自己的生日多要一盒蜡烛，打算插在面条上。
information_gap: 送别人的蛋糕，自己的生日却打算用面条插蜡烛。
payload: Full text of Sanlian documentary companion article: delivery cake, requested extra candles, upcoming birthday and quoted plan to put candles on noodles.
novelty_check: 387 campaign records source/body checked; no same delivery-birthday event. Recent20/50/100 comparison: C372 candle video search is unrelated technology; C272 dog wedding cake is distinct. C388 labour hours material has different person, detail and reader action.
audit_language_separation: Attribute to April17 Sanlian companion text. Anonymous rider; no income or hardship reason inferred. Candle request and planned use, not witnessed completed birthday. No nationwide censorship claim.
follow_reason: Continue showing sourced details of ordinary daily life that institutional summaries overlook.

checked_sections: cake delivery and extra candle request

domestic_visibility_evidence.affected_region_platform_time: Sanlian mainland original documentary/companion material; CDT specific404video archive May10
domestic_visibility_evidence.narrow_claim_supported: This particular material appears in CDT404video archive; category records material disappearance.
domestic_visibility_evidence.unknown_or_contrary: Original directURL unresolved, archive locator429, removal actor/reason and present original availability not independently observed. Do not claim all related text or all platforms blocked.

publication_review_exception: Standing ordinary public posting and per-item personal review waiver.

voice_review.final_read: 只留动作、出处与原话；不加苦难总结、道德判断、反问，也不编没钱买蛋糕或他已经把蜡烛插上。

reader_value_routes.cue: 送别人的蛋糕，自己的生日却打算用面条插蜡烛。
reader_value_routes.reader_thought: 我也有一个人过生日的时候。

reader_model.why_reader_cares: 读者能联想到自己的生日、在外工作的日常和想给自己留一点仪式的时刻。
reader_model.predicted_inner_response: 我也有一个人过生日的时候。
reader_model.share_recipient: 在外工作、曾自己过生日的朋友。
reader_model.share_reason: 一个真实的生日细节，让朋友看见骑手工作之外的生活；没有代替当事人诉苦或替读者判定。

experiment.pre_registered_hypothesis: Concrete sourced birthday contrast without editorial verdict may encourage genuine sharing; editorial hypothesis only, no validated account effect.
